title: 第8章 第一巴图鲁
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
第二天一早，

    太阳刚刚透过窗户，林奇就听到楼下就传来一阵细碎又急促的金属碰撞声，那是铁杵碾磨草药的“咯吱”声混着玻璃瓶碰撞的“叮当”响。

    不用想，肯定是林峰正在摆弄昨天的货物制作凝血药。

    林奇手一挥，一张卡牌凭空出现。

    “这都第八天了，怎么我还没有突破一星卡徒？还是说我得向萧炎似的，得连续用三年的源力才能将这本命卡激活？”

    一产生这可怕的想法，林奇就感觉前途一片漆黑。

    就在这时，楼下突然炸响的大嗓门像道惊雷，瞬间冲散了林奇的沮丧。

    “儿子，莱芙回来了，你快下楼。”

    “莱芙？”

    听到这个名字，林奇几乎是从床上弹坐起来。

    莱芙是他十岁时交的女朋友，去年觉醒出罕见的绿色资质本命卡，被家人送去新耀城的初级御卡学院后就一直没有回来。

    “莱芙现在肯定学了不少御卡知识，说不定能帮我解决本命卡的问题！” 林奇一边飞快地穿衣服，一边在心里盘算着，脚步急促地往楼下跑。

    刚跑下楼，林奇就看到客厅中央站着一个身着蓝色长裙的少女。

    少女长发及腰，发尾微微卷曲，皮肤白皙得像上好的瓷器，眉眼间比去年多了几分青涩的成熟。

    “莱芙，你回来了。”

    林奇上前一把抱住她，心情很是激动。

    莱芙身体有些僵硬，没有回抱他，声音平淡得没有一丝波澜。

    “我回来了。”

    没有等到预想中热烈的回应，林奇心底突然窜起一丝莫名的不安。

    “林奇，我有事要给你说。”

    莱芙避开他的目光，声音有些颤抖。

    林奇心里的不安更甚，他一把抓住莱芙冰凉的手，指尖能清晰地感受到她的颤抖。

    “走吧，去我房间里说。”

    看着儿子领着姑娘匆匆地上楼，林峰手里的药杵顿了顿，无奈的摇了摇头。

    房间内，

    木桌上还摊着他昨晚画的本命卡草图和源力分析数据，纸上密密麻麻写满了公式和疑问。

    莱芙坐在椅子上，双手攥着裙摆，指尖把浅蓝色的布料捏出几道褶皱，眼神躲闪着不敢看他。

    林奇先开了口，声音尽量放得温和，想驱散这莫名的尴尬。

    “莱芙，我有些事情想问你，你可以帮我解惑吗？”

    听到这温暖的声音，莱芙终于勇敢的抬起头。

    “好。”

    林奇往前凑了凑，眼里满是期待。

    “我想知道本命卡该如何晋升。你应该也知道我的卡是一根骨头了吧，可我爹说，王国有位御卡宗师，最早的本命卡只是朵花。”
content_en:
Early the next morning,

As soon as the sun passed through the window, Lin Qi heard a small and rapid collision of metals from downstairs. It was the "creak" of an iron pestle grinding herbs mixed with the "ding" of glass bottles.

Needless to say, Lin Feng must be playing with yesterday's goods to make coagulation medicine.

Lin Qi waved his hand, and a card appeared out of thin air.

"It's already the eighth day, why haven't I broken through the one-star card disciple yet? Or do I have to be like Xiao Yan, who has to use my source power for three consecutive years to activate this life card?"

As soon as he had this terrible thought, Lynch felt that his future was dark.

At this moment, a loud voice suddenly exploded downstairs like thunder, instantly dispelling Lin Qi's depression.

"Son, Leif is back. Come downstairs quickly."

"Leif?"

Hearing the name, Lynch almost sat up from the bed.

Leif was his girlfriend when he was ten years old. Last year, she awakened a rare green qualification natal card and was sent to the Junior Card Royal Academy in Xinyao City by her family and she never came back.

"Leif must have learned a lot about card control now, and maybe he can help me solve the problem of my life card!" Lin Qi quickly dressed, thinking in his mind, and ran downstairs quickly.

As soon as he ran downstairs, Lynch saw a girl in a blue dress standing in the middle of the living room.

The girl has waist-long hair with slightly curly ends. Her skin is as fair as fine porcelain, and her eyebrows are a bit more mature than last year.

"Leif, you're back."

Lin Qi stepped forward and hugged her, feeling very excited.

Leif's body was a little stiff, she didn't hug him back, and her voice was calm without any ripples.

"I'm back."

Instead of waiting for the expected enthusiastic response, Lin Qi suddenly felt an inexplicable uneasiness in his heart.

"Lynch, I have something to tell you."

Leif avoided his gaze, her voice trembling.

Lin Qi felt even more uneasy. He grabbed Leif's cold hand and could clearly feel her trembling on his fingertips.

"Let's go and talk in my room."

Seeing his son leading the girl hurriedly upstairs, Lin Feng paused with the medicine pestle in his hand and shook his head helplessly.

inside the room,

Also spread out on the wooden table were the birth card sketches and source force analysis data he drew last night. The paper was densely written with formulas and questions.

Leif sat on the chair, holding the hem of her skirt with both hands, pinching the light blue fabric into a few folds with her fingertips, her eyes evading and not daring to look at him.

Lin Qi spoke first, his voice as gentle as possible, trying to dispel the inexplicable embarrassment.

"Leif, I have something to ask you. Can you help me answer my questions?"

Hearing this warm voice, Leif finally raised her head bravely.

"Okay."

Lin Qi moved forward, his eyes full of anticipation.

"I want to know how to advance the life card. You should also know that my card is a bone, but my father said that there is a card master in the kingdom, and the earliest life card is just a flower."
